metadata.description: A small marketplace of Claude Code plugins: session-routines (/wind-down + /good-morning) and doc-from-chat (turn a session into docs).

plugins.name: session-routines
plugins.description: Start-of-day and end-of-day routines for Claude Code: /wind-down writes one consolidated brief across your sessions, /good-morning reads it back and re-checks what changed overnight.

plugins.name: doc-from-chat
plugins.description: Turns the conversation you just had into documentation: /doc-from-chat scans the session for how-it-works explanations and answered questions, verifies each claim against the code, then writes or updates docs in the project's docs/ folder.
